subject: Recap: SOC 2 discovery with ZenWell — next steps
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@zenwell.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-14T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Recap: SOC 2 discovery + next steps

Thanks for taking time today, Alex — appreciate the thoughtful questions. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps for ZenWell's SOC 2 / security evaluation.

Summary of pain points & goals (as we heard them)
- Primary goal: confirm Redwood's controls and evidence for SOC 2 Type II, pen test results, and audit log retention to satisfy ZenWell's security/compliance team.
- Pain points: need clarity on audit log retention windows, access controls for customer data, DPA terms around data residency, and proof of recent pen test scope & remediation.
- Constraint: ZenWell expects evidence in the next 2-3 weeks to feed into your vendor risk review for the August security board.

What we covered
- Redwood supports hosted, Dedicated (reserved capacity), and Private (VPC/on-prem) models — SOC 2 Type II covers hosted and Dedicated backplane controls; Private deployment has separate attestations and options.
- Audit logs: default retention for hosted audit logs is 90 days; Dedicated/Private options can be extended per contract.
- DPA & data residency: we have a standard DPA plus addenda for EU/UK; we can provide region-specific clauses.

Requested artifacts (we attached the first two):
- Redwood_SOC2_Type_II_2026.pdf (attached) — full report redacted for public distribution.
- PenTest_Summary_2026.pdf — high-level findings and remediation timeline (we'll share a scoped executive summary).
- We also linked a shared folder for additional artifacts (see related links).

Proposed next steps
1) Marissa (Security) and Rishi (Solutions) to run a technical deep-dive next week to walk your security reviewers through logs, key management, and network isolation.
2) Alex / Priya: please complete and return your security questionnaire (you mentioned a standard vendor questionnaire) — we can ingest that and call out answers.
3) I'll share the DPA and pen test executive summary via the Drive link; if you need full artifacts under an NDA, we'll coordinate.

Proposed times for the technical deep-dive:
- Tue 7/20 10:00-11:00 PT
- Wed 7/21 14:00-15:00 PT

If either of those works I can lock it in. Let me know any additional questions.

Best,
Neha Kapoor

neha@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Thanks Neha — very helpful summary. A few clarifying questions from our security team: 

1) Audit logs: you mentioned 90 days by default for hosted. Can you confirm the types of events captured (admin auth, API calls, user activity, system changes) and whether logs are tamper-evident / WORM-enabled?
2) Retention for Dedicated: is extended retention billed as an add-on? Do you support export of log archives to customer-managed S3?
3) Pen test: can you confirm whether the pen test included social engineering or only application/network-level testing? Any critical CVEs outstanding?
4) DPA: we need an exportability clause and a 3-year retention baseline — can you point me to the DPA text or the clause number?

Also attaching our standard questionnaire (ZenWell_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx) — can your team fill the marked fields and return by 7/21?

On the technical deep-dive: Wed 7/21 14:00-15:00 PT works for us. Please confirm and send a calendar invite.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Recap: SOC 2 discovery + next steps (answers & artifacts)

Hi Alex — looping in answers and a couple of artifacts to help your review. Short answers below and attachments included. Happy to go deeper on the call Wednesday.

Audit logging
- Events captured: admin authentication, API calls (with API key identifiers), user account changes, role assignments, config changes, system alerts, and provisioning events.
- Tamper evidence: logs are stored with integrity checks and write-once append-only storage for the hosted control plane; we can provide SHA256 digests for archived log bundles.
- Export: yes — for Dedicated and Private deployments we can export logs to a customer-managed S3 bucket; for hosted customers we provide export APIs and scheduled archival jobs on request (export may be subject to data transfer fees).

Retention & billing
- Hosted default: 90 days. Extended retention to 365 days available as a paid add-on (line-item in Dedicated contracts). Private deployments are customer-configurable per SOW.

Pen test
- Scope: 3rd-party vendor performed application and network testing (no social-engineering). No critical CVEs outstanding; high findings were remediated in Q4 2026 and verified. We can provide the full vendor report under NDA. See PenTest_Summary_2026.pdf (attached) for executive findings.

DPA & data residency
- DPA: standard DPA is available at https://www.redwood.com/dpa (we'll also drop a copy in the Drive folder). For EU/UK residency we offer an addendum; we can send the text and clause references once you confirm region.

Next steps (confirming Neha's suggestions)
- Wed 7/21 14:00-15:00 PT — technical deep-dive (Marissa + Rishi). I'll cover logging, key management (KMS/HSM options), and evidence hand-off practices.
- Please return the completed ZenWell_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx by EOD 7/21; we'll annotate answers inline and reference artifacts.
- If you need full pen test report or unredacted SOC 2 attachments we'll put those behind an NDA — we can start that flow if you'd like.

Attachments: SOC2-TypeII-2026-summary.txt (stub), PenTest_Summary_2026.pdf (stub)

Regards,
